sloka: छत्रं धारयत क्षिप्रमार्यपादाविमौ मतौ ।आभ्यां राज्ये स्थितो धर्म: पादुकाभ्यां गुरोर्मम ॥ २.११५.१६॥
transliteration: chatraṁ dhārayata kṣipramāryapādāvimau matau ।ābhyāṁ rājye sthito dharma: pādukābhyāṁ gurormama ॥ 2.115.16॥

translations.english: Hold the royal paresol now. This is the accepted symbol of the exalted feet of my brother. These sandals shall establish righteousness in the kingdom.
